$comment: The reference environment every performance result in plan/00-foundation/07-quality-attributes.md
is measured against. Recorded at M0 per D-45: M0 installs the harness and records the environment;
each budget's baseline is recorded by the milestone that first produces the artifact it measures.
Changing the hardware class requires a reviewed baseline update, not a silently relaxed threshold.

os.note: WSL2 on Windows. A native Windows or Linux runner will differ; CI records its own.

hardware.powerMode: unknown - record explicitly on a laptop runner

protocol.note: Every result also records its sample file and the model counts it was measured on.

baselines.$comment: Empty by design at M0. Each milestone adds the rows for the artifact it first produces.
